container: Overpopulation presents a myriad of challenges that affect both the environment and quality of life. One of the most pressing issues is resource depletion as the demand for water, food, and energy increases. This surge in consumption leads to environmental degradation, including deforestation and loss of biodiversity. Additionally, overpopulation contributes to overcrowded cities, putting immense pressure on infrastructure such as transportation, healthcare, and education systems. Economic challenges are also significant, as job markets struggle to accommodate the growing workforce, leading to higher unemployment rates and poverty. Furthermore, overpopulation exacerbates social inequalities and strains public services. The escalating volume of waste and pollution further endangers public health. Addressing these challenges requires comprehensive policies and global cooperation to ensure sustainable development and improved living conditions.
